info.title: OpenClinic — Electronic Health Record (EHR) & Governance API
info.description: Open, modular, and auditable Electronic Health Record (EHR) and Clinical Management API with hybrid access control (RBAC + ACL), multi-tenancy, dynamic capabilities resolution, and enterprise security (Argon2id + in-memory JWT).
